details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3928-3929 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `count_noop_ancestors()` uses a case-sensitive `contains()` match for the no-op marker, so capitalization changes can make the ancestor-chain cap miss prior no-op comments.
  WHY: All reviewers flagged the same fragile marker detection; the highest severity/confidence reported was high/5, and the issue can silently bypass the safety cap.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4393-4398 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The managed stall-recovery `close_and_reissue` path omits `--remove-label 'ai:ready-to-merge'`, leaving a stale label on closed/reissued issues.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers identified the same label-cleanup omission; severity stays medium because it is an inconsistency/automation-hygiene issue rather than a direct crash.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4397-4398 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The managed stall-recovery path does not match the standalone path’s label cleanup behavior when closing and reissuing.
  WHY: This is the same root cause as the missing `ai:ready-to-merge` removal, but the reviewer reported it as a distinct inconsistency at this location.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4386,4390,8793,8797 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `${MAX_IMPL_NOOP_REISSUES}` is used without a default at the call sites, so an unset or empty value can trigger shell comparison errors.
  WHY: Several reviewers flagged this as a runtime robustness issue; one reviewer disagreed and said the existing normalization block already prevents it, so the consensus keeps the reported severity/confidence from the majority while noting the disagreement.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1893-1894 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `parent_has_noop` command substitution lacks fail-open error handling, and the `awk` accumulation accepts unfiltered input.
  WHY: Reviewers consistently flagged transient API failure handling and loose numeric parsing in the same block; one reviewer considered the `set -e` interaction only partially confirmed, but the highest reported severity/confidence is medium/5.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8800-8801,8828-8829 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The no-op sweep closure path removes too few labels, leaving other phase labels stale on closed issues.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding that remains distinct from the managed stall-recovery label omission because it targets a different closure path and a broader cleanup gap.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8801 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The closure path only removes `ai:implementation-failed`, not the other phase labels.
  WHY: This is the same root cause as the broader label-cleanup issue in the no-op sweep closure path, but the reviewers attached it to this specific line and described it as a minor inconsistency.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1809 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The pathspec regex may miss some porcelain output formats because the `\b` boundary is brittle.
  WHY: This was only raised by one reviewer and explicitly described as speculative/low-confidence.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3908-3939 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `count_noop_ancestors()` does not verify that the parent issue belongs to the same repository before walking the re-issue chain.
  WHY: Single-reviewer finding; the reviewer characterized the impact as minor and the risk as a false-positive cap hit.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3921,5813; .github/workflows/implement.yml:1873 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `seq`-based hop loop could hit argument-list limits if the threshold is set extremely high.
  WHY: Single-reviewer robustness concern with low confidence; the reviewer noted the defaults are small and this is not a blocker.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3929 and .github/workflows/implement.yml:1894 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `contains()` is case-sensitive; should use `test("${noop_marker}"; "i")` for case-insensitive matching
  WHY: Clear bug that would break detection
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3928 and .github/workflows/implement.yml:1893 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gh_retry` failure in command substitution causes script exit under `set -euo pipefail`
  WHY: Would cause script to exit instead of fail-open
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4386,4390,8793,8797 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Variable referenced before being defaulted at line 5988
  WHY: Could cause `integer expression expected` errors
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4397-4398 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Inconsistent with standalone path (line 5830)
  WHY: Stale label could confuse downstream automation
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1894 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `awk` should filter for numeric input; contains() is case-sensitive
  WHY: Non-numeric input could cause errors; case changes break detection
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1809 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `\b` word boundary may not work with space-prefixed paths in porcelain output
  WHY: Could miss some pathspec-stripped changes
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8801 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Only removes implementation-failed label, not other phase labels
  WHY: Minor confusion but not functional breakage
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3929 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `contains()` in `jq` and the variable `noop_marker` use case-sensitive matching.
  WHY: If the no-op warning message capitalization changes, the belt-and-braces cap will silently fail to detect ancestors, re-enabling the runaway loop.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4397 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The managed stall-recovery `close_and_reissue` path omits `--remove-label 'ai:ready-to-merge'`.
  WHY: Closed and re-issued issues can retain an incorrect phase label, which is inconsistent with the standalone path and can confuse downstream automation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4386, 4390, 8793, 8797 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `${MAX_IMPL_NOOP_REISSUES}` is used without a default value shell substitution.
  WHY: If the variable is unset or empty, the shell will throw an "integer expression expected" error, potentially crashing the poller tick.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1894 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `awk` command lacks a guard for non-numeric input.
  WHY: If `gh api` or `jq` returns an empty string or error message, the `awk` sum can produce unexpected results or fail the step.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1893 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `parent_has_noop` command substitution lacks a fail-open shell guard.
  WHY: Under `set -e`, a transient GitHub API error during ancestor lookups will terminate the entire `implement.yml` job instead of falling through to the safe legacy path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8801 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The closure path in the no-op sweep removes only `ai:implementation-failed`.
  WHY: Issues that carried `ai:done` or `ai:implementing` before being closed for no-ops will keep those labels stale.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1893-1894 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The command substitution for `parent_has_noop` lacks explicit failure handling, and the `awk` sum has loose numeric filtering.
  WHY: If `gh_retry` fails or `jq` outputs empty/error text, the substitution can fail instead of failing open.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4386, 4390, 87,93, 87,97 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `${MAX_IMPL_NOOP_REISSUES}` is used directly without a default value.
  WHY: If the variable is unset or empty in the environment, arithmetic comparisons will fail with "integer expression expected" errors.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4394-4399 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The managed stall-recovery `close_and_reissue` path does NOT remove `ai:ready-to-merge`.
  WHY: This inconsistency can leave stale labels on closed issues.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:39,917 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `contains()` match is case-sensitive.
  WHY: If the warning message text changes capitalization, detection fails silently and the ancestor-chain cap breaks.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:19,17-19,21 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The closure path removes only `ai:implementation-failed`, leaving other phase labels stale on the closed issue.
  WHY: This is a label-hygiene inconsistency rather than a direct runtime failure.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4386, 4393-4397 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The managed stall-recovery `close_and_reissue` path is missing `--remove-label 'ai:ready-to-merge'` when closing issues.
  WHY: If an issue reaches `close_and_reissue` while carrying `ai:ready-to-merge`, the label persists on the closed issue and can confuse downstream automation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~3929 (in count_noop_ancestors function) | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The jq `contains("${noop_marker}")` filter is case-sensitive, using the hardcoded lowercase marker "produced no repository changes".
  WHY: If the no-op warning comment emitted by `implement.yml` changes capitalization, the ancestor-chain cap detection fails silently and can allow infinite re-issue loops.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~1893-1894 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The command substitution for `parent_has_noop` lacks explicit failure handling, and the `awk` sum has loose numeric filtering.
  WHY: The reviewer considered the `set -e` interaction subtle and the double-negative fallback fragile.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~8801 (in ai:implementation-failed branch) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The closure path only removes `ai:implementation-failed` label before adding `ai:closed`.
  WHY: Other phase labels may remain on the closed issue, leaving it in an inconsistent state.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3928 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The assignment `parent_has_noop="$(gh_retry gh api … )"` has no failure guard.
  WHY: Under `set -euo pipefail`, a non-zero exit from `gh_retry` aborts the entire poller instead of falling back to 0.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1893 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The same `parent_has_noop` command substitution in the workflow lacks a guard.
  WHY: A transient GitHub API error would abort the implementation job instead of treating it as a non-matching/no-op ance
